messages.content: Kaise ho?
Main theek hoon, thanks for asking!
Sunday ko kya plan hai?
Shayad movie dekhne jaun.
Kya chal raha hai?
Bas kaam kar raha hoon, tum batao?
Mausam kaisa hai aaj?
Lagta hai baarish ho sakti hai, chhata le lena!
Mujhe chai chahiye.
Bilkul, ek chai le aate hain!
Main bored ho gaya hoon.
Chalo kuch mazedaar karte hain, game kheloge?
Kahan ja rahe ho?
Bas thoda kaam karne ja raha hoon.
Kya tum location share kar sakte ho?
Haan, main aapko location bhej raha hoon abhi.
Tum itne smart kyun ho?
Kyunki mujhe AI ka ashirwad mila hai
Tum kya karte ho?
Main ek software developer hoon.
Internet kaam nahi kar raha hai.
Main aapka connection check kar raha hoon, ek minute dein.
Kya main apna issue resolve kar sakta hoon?
Ji haan, aap apna issue resolve kar sakte ho, main madad karunga.
Call ko transfer karna hai.
Main aapka call transfer kar raha hoon, thoda intezaar karein.
Mere account ka balance check karna hai.
Main abhi aapka account balance check karta hoon.
Mujhe apna password reset karna hai.
Password reset ke liye main aapko ek link bhej raha hoon.
Mujhe technical support chahiye.
Main aapko technical support se connect kar raha hoon.
Account verification ke liye kya karna hoga?
Account verification ke liye main aapko ek OTP bhej raha hoon.
Main apna order cancel karna chahta hoon.
Main aapka order cancel kar raha hoon.
Customer support ko call karna hai.
Main aapko customer support ko connect kar raha hoon.
Mujhe order status jaana hai.
Main aapka order status check kar raha hoon.
